notes.text: Complete different-reader second reading of this page only. Original and both native halves were inspected once each, followed by nine existing tight crops. No new crop, OCR, research or TeX compilation was used.

Two proposed changes: remove the unsupported tilde from the first right-hand factor in the final formula; replace the curly underbrace by the source shallow left-upturned rule and preserve the two-line annotation. Their excerpts overlap because the second replacement encloses the first factor.

The initial suggestion to reverse the marginal separator slope is withdrawn. It compared native sheet coordinates with an upright rendering of a rotated note. After distinguishing those coordinate frames, no independent note-relative geometry mismatch remains; the accepted separator is unchanged.

The tiny second-Psi index remains an explicitly doubtful j. Its existing evidence description is qualified to acknowledge two short stacked strokes and a possible correction mark; no literal equals index is introduced. The count of retained doubts stays five.
All fourteen original MARKS decisions, M0674–M0687, were revisited and retained. No new MARKS identifier is created. The final-factor accent issue is not one of those original MARKS.

The heading number disagreement, unclosed puisque parenthesis, abbreviations without added periods, different local map-letter shapes, canceled possible exponent and low wedge index remain literal. No mathematical normalization was used to choose the unaccented final factor.
Pencil pagination 14 remains by an unidentified hand. Neither the audit nor the source establishes a date or a named pagination author.
